data.case_title: Health insurance student rate – proof of enrolment needed
data.title: Student rate: proof of enrolment needed – Beispielvita Expat Health AG
data.summary: Beispielvita Expat Health AG asks Mr Asante to send a certificate of enrolment for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027 to keep his student health insurance rate; otherwise the policy will switch to the standard rate from February 2027.
data.explanation: Your health insurer needs proof that you are still enrolled as a student each semester to keep the cheaper student rate. Send the certificate of enrolment (Immatrikulationsbescheinigung) for the current semester to the insurer by the deadline shown. If it does not arrive in time, your insurance will automatically move to the more expensive standard rate from February 2027. If you are no longer a student or cannot get the certificate in time, contact the insurer to discuss your options.
data.tax_note: Health insurance contributions are generally deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in the German tax return; keep records of premiums paid under this policy.

items.title: Send certificate of enrolment for winter semester 2026/27
items.action: Send your current certificate of enrolment (Immatrikulationsbescheinigung) for the winter semester 2026/27 to your health insurer.
items.consequence: If the certificate does not arrive in time, your policy will be switched from the student rate to the standard rate starting February 2027.
items.quote: Please send us the certificate for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027.
